title: Intelligence Repair — source first, no transcript spam
summary: The clean 17-section shell now separates the analysed video's topic from Creator DNA, gates Creator DNA behind sign-in, removes the Monday Brief label and replaces repetitive transcript dumps with source-specific intelligence plus reviewed model synthesis when available.
discord_changes: SOURCE DNA FIX: niche + subniche now describe the analysed video, never the creator profile.
INTELLIGENCE FIX: hooks, re-hooks, payoffs and stealable mechanics are deduplicated and interpreted instead of repeating transcript blocks.
AUTH + UX FIX: Creator DNA is only shown after sign-in and the old Monday Brief label is gone.
changes: Added v351-intelligence-repair.js as the new single browser entry point while preserving the v0.35 Heart Lock layout.
Restored the canonical YTIntel authentication layer before Creator DNA is exposed; the Creator DNA card is hidden by default until an authenticated session is established.
Separated creator-tailoring metadata from source-video classification so the strip and vault store the analysed video's niche/subniche, not the user's own niche/subniche.
Added source classification for mixed topics such as AI + e-commerce and explicit source-specific subniches such as Claude workflows for organic dropshipping.
Removed the visible Monday Brief branding from analysis sections; the report now identifies itself as YTIntel Analysis.
Rebuilt hook analysis around distinct opening-line functions with concise receipts instead of overlapping transcript windows.
Rebuilt re-hooks around distinct attention resets and suppressed duplicate rolling-caption blocks.
Rebuilt payoffs around distinct evidence/result moments, preventing the same source paragraph from being printed every 30 seconds.
Rebuilt Things to Steal around transferable mechanisms and explicit do-not-copy constraints.
Reconnected the reviewed deep-research model pipeline so summary, takeaways, mechanics and creator-tailored remake can replace deterministic output after passing source/evidence quality gates.
Kept the strong Packaging section and the clean 17-section visual structure intact while repairing the intelligence underneath it.
Updated the PWA shell/cache so v0.35.1 and its auth/intelligence dependencies refresh cleanly on installed devices.
known_limitations: Full frame-by-frame inspection still requires actual frame/video evidence; YTIntel will not invent motion graphics, transitions or B-roll when the source does not expose usable media.
Acoustic music/SFX analysis is not claimed when raw audio is unavailable.
Most Replayed is only treated as measured when a public replay curve is exposed; otherwise replay-related interpretation remains explicitly limited.

Reviewed frontier synthesis depends on the configured server-side model provider having usable quota/credits. If it is unavailable, the deduplicated deterministic evidence pass remains active rather than fabricating model output.
why_it_matters: The previous build looked sophisticated but too often behaved like a transcript viewer. This release keeps the premium structure and makes the core analysis materially more source-specific, non-repetitive and useful.
